treatment_plan_1: Root canal therapy for teeth 11, 31, 32, 41, and 42.
management_1: After explaining the condition to the patient and obtaining informed consent, local infiltration anesthesia was administered using articaine. Under rubber dam isolation, caries were removed using high-speed and slow-speed burs, followed by pulp extirpation and canal debridement. Root canal lengths were measured (11: 20mm, 32: 21.5mm, 31: 18mm, 41: 18mm, 42: 20mm). Canals were prepared using large taper rotary files (35#06) and irrigated with 2.5% sodium hypochlorite and distilled water. Calcium hydroxide was placed as an intracanal medicament, and the canals were temporarily sealed.

management_1: For teeth 31, 41, and 42, the patient was informed of the condition and consented to treatment. Supragingival scaling, subgingival curettage, and manual root planing were performed. Full-mouth air polishing, tooth surface cleaning, irrigation, and application of gingival protectant were completed. treatment_plan_1: Root canal therapy for teeth 11, 31, 32, 41, and 42.
management_1: For teeth 11, 31, 32, 41, and 42, the patient was informed about the condition and consented to treatment. Under local infiltration anesthesia with articaine and rubber dam isolation, caries were removed using high-speed and slow-speed burs, access was gained, pulp was extirpated, and canals were negotiated. Canal lengths were measured (11: 20mm, 32: 21.5mm, 31: 18mm, 41: 18mm, 42: 20mm). Canals were prepared using a large taper technique with 35#06 files, irrigated with 2.5% sodium hypochlorite and distilled water, and sealed with calcium hydroxide for temporary closure.

Full-thickness flaps were raised, and osteotomies were prepared to the planned depth. A BEGO implant (3.75x10mm) was placed in tooth 15 with a healing abutment (4.5x5mm), a BEGO implant (3.75x10mm) in tooth 44 with a cover screw, and a BEGO implant (4.5x10mm) in tooth 46 with a cover screw. Tension-free suturing was performed, and radiographs confirmed correct positioning. Sutures were removed from teeth 34 and 36 after disinfection.
